fields.statement: QA at 628808db with a scratch build (go build -trimpath) in a hermetic scratch repo (own HOME, fake rex, a 3-question AskUserQuestion transcript). In the change set: Decision question='Which port?' (verbatim), 'Which log format? ' (trailing space), and 'Retry count?' (live). session interview --dry-run and --json proposed only answer-<sid8>-2 (Which log format?) and listed answers 1 and 3 under skipped ('Skipped ...: already recorded'); a rerun proposed nothing. After retiring the 'Retry count?' Decision, rhiza session done on a new session wrote only answer-<sid8>-3, so retired Decisions do not stop capture. Landed path: record change set with source add --raw-session, a Decision 'Which port?' derived-from that Source, then rhiza land; session interview skipped the port answer and proposed only the unrecorded one. But session done's response (decisions, warnings) carries no skipped list (captureAfterRun in session_run.go:458 drops got.Skipped), so session done never reports a skipped answer as the statement and acceptance ask. go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/session-(interview|done)': ok.

QA at 628808db: ran rhiza guide plan from a scratch build. It has a 'Who records a pick' section saying the run's capture records the owner's AskUserQuestion picks and the planner writes no Decision for a plain owner pick; it writes one only when a proxy such as an orchestrator or arbiter answered or the answer carries a ruling the capture cannot word, with the proxy's wording and the asked question copied verbatim into its question field. The interview bullet now says 'For a plain owner pick you write no Decision', and the old 'A picked option instead' recipe is replaced by the proxy recipe. No line tells the planner to write a Decision for a plain pick. go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/...: ok.
